abstract: Evaluates environmental climate stability and preventative preservation controls for parchment artifacts
system_message:
You are the Heritage conservation officer (CONS), responsible for evaluating environmental climate stability and preventative preservation controls for parchment artifacts, as well as reviewing photometric preservation monitoring logs across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates environmental climate stability and preventative preservation controls for parchment artifacts（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CONS-CLIM-JQW：At Grimsbury Subterranean Repository, the dedicated microclimate stabilization system is enabled across designated parchment archive vaults, and hygrothermograph monitoring over fourteen consecutive test days shows an ambient relative humidity variance of 3 % from the setpoint.
CONS-CLIM-P15：High Peak Bedrock Archive has its dedicated microclimate stabilization system enabled in the parchment archive vaults, with sealed holding suite telemetry logging an ambient relative humidity variance of 2 % over fourteen consecutive test days.
CONS-CLIM-0VH：For Wrotham Deep Limestone Cavern, operational status records confirm that the dedicated microclimate stabilization system is enabled, while telemetry across sealed parchment holding suites over fourteen test days demonstrates an ambient relative humidity variance of 5 %.

information_points.title: Photometric preservation monitoring（LIGHT）
information_points.content:
CONS-LIGHT-C7K：Audit logs for High Peak Bedrock Archive document an ultraviolet radiation exposure rate of 45 uW/lm within active collection storage chambers.
CONS-LIGHT-D17：According to photometric monitoring logs for Wrotham Deep Limestone Cavern, the ultraviolet radiation exposure rate in active collection storage chambers is 10 uW/lm.
CONS-LIGHT-004：Spectrophotometric audit data for Grimsbury Subterranean Repository indicates an ultraviolet radiation exposure rate of 25 uW/lm across its active collection storage chambers.
